description_en: Queries the details of route entries in a specific region of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries接口查询云企业网实例中具体地域内路由条目的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-region-domain-route-entries --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6j0000 --cen-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --status Active --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: cen_region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page during paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

Active (default): active.

Candidate: backup.

Rejected: rejected.

Prohibited: prohibited.

All: queries route entries in all states in the current region
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的状态。取值：

Active（默认值）：可用。

Candidate：候选路由，网关设备未下发，主路由被撤销后生效。

Standby：备份路由，网关设备已下发。

Rejected：拒绝。

Prohibited：禁用。

All：表示查询当前地域下所有状态的路由条目信息
parameters.name: status

CenRouteEntry.description_en: The list of routing entry information

AsPath.description_en: The list of AS Path attribute values of the route entry
AsPath.description_zh: 路由条目的AS Path属性值列表

items.description_en: The AS Path attribute value of the route entry
items.description_zh: 路由条目的AS Path属性值

CenOutRouteMapRecord.description_en: The routing policy that the route entry matches in the outbound direction of the regional gateway
CenOutRouteMapRecord.description_zh: 路由条目匹配到的出地域网关方向的路由策略

RegionId.description_en: The region ID where the routing policy is applied

RouteMapId.description_en: The ID of the routing policy

CenRouteMapRecord.description_en: The routing policy that the route entry matches in the inbound direction of the regional gateway
CenRouteMapRecord.description_zh: 路由条目匹配到的入地域网关方向的路由策略

RegionId.description_en: The region ID where the routing policy is applied

RouteMapId.description_en: The ID of the routing policy

Community.description_en: The list of Community attribute values of the route entry
Community.description_zh: 路由条目的Community属性值列表

items.description_en: The Community attribute value of the route entry

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

NextHopInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the network instance associated with the next hop of the route entry
NextHopInstanceId.description_zh: 路由条目下一跳关联的网络实例ID

NextHopRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the network instance associated with the next hop of the route entry
NextHopRegionId.description_zh: 路由条目下一跳关联的网络实例所属的地域ID

NextHopType.description_en:
The next hop type of the route entry.

VPC: virtual private cloud.
VBR: virtual border router.
CCN: Cloud Connect Network.
local_service: the route entry is a cloud service system route with no next hop
NextHopType.description_zh:
路由条目下一跳类型。

VPC：专有网络。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网。
local_service：表示当前路由条目为云服务系统路由，没有下一跳

Preference.description_en:
The priority of the route entry.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Preference.description_zh:
路由条目的优先级。

优先级数字越小，表示优先级越高

Status.description_en:
The status of the route entry.

Active: active.

Candidate: backup.

Rejected: rejected.

Prohibited: prohibited
Status.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。

Active：可用。

Candidate：备份。

Rejected：拒绝。

Prohibited：禁用

ToOtherRegionStatus.description_en:
The status of the route entry destined for other regions.

Active: active.
Prohibited: prohibited
ToOtherRegionStatus.description_zh:
路由条目去往其他地域的状态。

Active：可用。
Prohibited：禁用

Type.description_en:
The type of the route entry.

CEN: a route entry propagated through CEN.
Custom: a custom route.
System: a system route
Type.description_zh:
路由条目的类型。

CEN：表示通过云企业网传递的路由。
Custom：表示自定义路由。
System：表示系统路由

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page during paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数
